items.body: Mondträume is finally back in action with their first new album in seven years. The Spanish band remains driven by Pikotto VondMond, now officially joined by vocalist Nicky Schulschenk (known from N-Frequency). Schulschenk took over from Damasius Venys three years ago and has already featured on the band’s recent EPs. This new album delivers 12 tracks, while the ‘Deluxe Edition’ includes a bonus disc with another 12 songs, comprising additional tracks, remixes, and collaborations. Musically, Mondträume stays true to their infectious, danceable Future-Pop-driven sound. But can we still call it Future-Pop today? Is the genre due for a revival, or is this a kind of ‘Post-Future-Pop’ sound? Ultimately, it doesn’t really matter; the band simply does its own thing, resulting in a polished and complete-sounding album. Danceable rhythms underpin melodies that, devoid of excessive melancholy, come across as cheerful and uplifting. While there are occasional moody passages that provide some variation, the overall production is captivating. Here and there, you’ll notice subtle changes, such as harder, more EBM-oriented basslines, but this is simply part of the genre’s characteristic sound. Previously released tracks such as “Poisoned Love” and, especially, “Pictures Of You” remain fantastic songs that showcase Mondträume at their best. Replacing Damasius Venys was certainly a challenge, but there is clear chemistry between the new duo. Three tracks also feature female vocals by Madril. As mentioned earlier, the bonus disc offers 12 additional tracks, although these aren’t necessarily among my personal favorites. The remixes are the real highlights here, featuring contributions from established remixers such as Rob Dust, while Code 64 and Beyond Border also provide some pleasant surprises. There is even a sort of tribute to Bruderschaft in the form of a remix of “Falling” that Mondträume created some time ago. The ‘Deluxe Edition’ seems primarily aimed at the absolute die-hard fans, but the standard album will undoubtedly attract new listeners as well. Mondträume is back and continues to deliver high-quality Future-Pop. (Rating:8½). Side-Line reported the 2CD announcement for “Mindgames” back in April. Listen to “Pictures Of You”: Pictures Of You by Mondträume About Mondträume Mondträume is a Spanish synth-pop/future-pop duo built around Pikotto Vond Mond. The project released the “The Unknown Path” EP on Alfa Matrix in 2022, followed by the “Heart Machine” EP in 2023 and the “Poisoned Love” single in 2024, before “Mindgames”. Nicky Schulschenk, also known from N-Frequency, took over lead vocal duties from Damasius Venys and discussed the transition in a February 2025 Side-Line interview.
items._cn_summary: Mondträume 沉寂七年后携新专辑回归，以 Pikotto VondMond 为核心并加入新主唱 Nicky Schulschenk。专辑包含 12 首曲目及豪华版额外 12 首混音与合作曲目，延续了乐队标志性的舞曲节奏与旋律化合成器编配，整体氛围明亮上扬而非过度阴郁。制作精良且完整，偶尔穿插 EBM 风格的低音线条以增加层次变化。前作《Poisoned Love》与《Pictures Of You》被认为是乐队最佳单曲的延续。女声客串和与 Code 64、Beyond Border 等同门的合作混音为专辑增添了多样性。该专辑是舞曲导向的未来流行类型作品，旋律抓耳但缺乏实验性突破，更注重类型内部的成熟打磨而非革新探索。

items.body: 今週も世界中の最新ジャズニュースから気になるトピックをピックアップ。 サックスという楽器が抱えてきた振れ幅を、今週は何度も思い出させられる。コルトレーン生誕100年の節目、ブランフォード・マルサリスとダイアン・リーヴスの共演、ローランド・カーク晩年の実験、そしてアンディ・シェパードとジョーイ・アレクサンダーの新作。世代も国籍も異なる5つの動きを追う。 ブランフォード・マルサリスとダイアン・リーヴス、Blue Noteでの再会 ブランフォード・マルサリス・カルテットと、ヴォーカリストのダイアン・リーヴスによるコラボレーションアルバム『Dedicated To You』が、Blue Noteからリリースされた（UK Vibe誌のレビュー）。出典で確認できるのはブラックヴァイナル仕様と限定カラー盤の存在までで、CDでの発売については出典本文に記載がないため、ここでは触れない。 ブランフォードは、弟ウィントン・マルサリスと並び称されてきたソプラノ／テナー奏者で、2002年作『Footsteps of Our Fathers』でジョン・コルトレーンの『A Love Supreme』を完全収録した経緯を持つ人物でもある。一方のダイアン・リーヴスは、10代の頃にクラーク・テリーからスタンダード・レパートリーの手ほどきを受け、1977年には「カルデラ」への参加を経て、1987年にBlue Noteと契約した最初の歌手となった歌い手である。系譜の異なる二人が同じ盤の上で言葉を交わす構図に、このアルバムの聴きどころがある。 出典：https://ukvibe.org/album_reviews/branford-marsalis-dianne-reeves ローランド・カーク、晩年の「新しさへの追求」 マルチリード奏者ローランド・カークの晩年の意欲作『Slightly Latin』が、Jazz Journal誌のコラム「JJ 09/66」で改めて取り上げられている。トロンボーン奏者ギャレット・ブラウンとの共同編成のもと、ラテン音楽の要素を取り込み、カーク特有の角ばった音色をより柔らかく響かせようとした一枚だという。 本作の背景には、1960年代半ばのジャズシーンにラテン音楽の語彙が浸透していった時期の空気がある。カークがバリトン・サックスという新たな声を得ようとしていたことも、Jazz Journalの評は伝えている。同誌はこの模索を「新しさへの絶えない追求」と評した。   出典：https://jazzjournal.co.uk/2026/09/20/jj-09-66-roland-kirk-slightly-latin アンディ・シェパード、静謐に寄せる5作目 イギリスのサックス奏者アンディ・シェパードの5作目となる新作『Salt Catchers』が、ECMから発表された（UK Jazz News）。出典によれば、本作は伝統に根ざした叙情性と、音数を絞った静けさを湛えた一枚だという。 シェパードは、ピアニストのリタ・マルコトゥッリ、ベーシストのミシェル・ベニータら長年の共演者と再びこの一枚を作り上げた。出典によれば、シェパード自身はキャラ・ブレイの「Lawns」をこれまでライブでは演奏してきたが録音してこなかったといい、今回初めて本作で録音に収めたという逸話も紹介されている。ここでは、シェパード個人がこの叙情性とどう向き合ってきたかという、小さな一点に絞って触れておく。 出典：https://ukjazznews.com/andy-sheppard-salt-catchers ジョーイ・アレクサンダー、10歳で世界に見出された歩み ジャズピアニスト、ジョーイ・アレクサンダーを取り上げた評論記事が『UK Jazz News』に掲載された。バリ島出身の彼は、2014年、10歳でニューヨークに移り住んだ直後にその演奏がウィントン・マルサリスの目に留まり、そこから国際的なジャズシーンへ足を踏み入れた経歴を持つ。 「アジア発のジャズプレイヤーが国際的に認識される時代」という大きな見立てを、今回の出典1件だけで裏づけるのは難しい。ここでは、一人のピアニストがどこから歩き出し、誰に見出されたかという個人史の線を辿るに留める。 出典：https://ukjazznews.com/joey-alexander コルトレーン生誕100年の節目に ジョン・コルトレーンが生まれてから、今年で100年になる。NPRのジャズ評論欄では、この節目に寄せた論考が公開されている（NPR、2026年9月22日）。 今回参照できた素材は表題と概要のみで、論考本文の具体的な主張までは確認できていない。テナー・サックス奏者としての革新性については、出典本文を確認できた段階で改めて扱いたい。 出典：https://www.npr.org/2026/09/22/nx-s1-5976887/marking-the-100th-birthday-of-jazz-great-john-coltrane 投稿 【ARBAN WEEKLY ／今週の話題まとめ】コルトレーン生誕100年、そしてブランフォードとリーヴスの邂逅ほか は ARBAN に最初に表示されました。

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

Vanishment
(Review)

Genuine Negro Jig
(Review)

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Dominique Cravic与Les Primitifs du futur的第五张作品，由地下漫画家Robert Crumb担任封面绘制。乐评描述其融合了bal-musette手风琴传统、法国香颂、拉格泰姆、jug乐队、skiffle等多种老派风格，乐队成员多已年过七旬，但以认真的态度重新演绎那些被遗忘的曲目。乐器组合极为丰富，包括手风琴、萨克斯、木琴、单簧管、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他、风笛及音乐锯等，营造出从旧物堆中挖掘出来的怀旧质感。专辑中既有幽默翻唱1925年的《Ukulele Lady》，也有向法国抵抗运动女歌手Juliette Gréco致敬的严肃作品。Cravic以近似Maurice Chevalier的方式说唱演绎27首短曲，将多种风格编织成一张难以归类的奇特拼贴。评论将其与Dan Hicks & His Hot Licks相提并论，强调其虽古怪却充满热情与匠心，在自己的小角落里散发着独特光芒。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统意义上的音乐作品，而是由录音师伊恩·布伦南在芝加哥南区的街头采集的田野录音合集。25位遭受枪支暴力影响的居民在录音当天参与其中，年龄从17岁到67岁不等，地点位于一位94岁祖母家前廊，正值特朗普下令国民警卫队进驻芝加哥之时。专辑中包含一些即兴说唱，但主体是普通居民对暴力创伤的真实讲述。一位失去两个儿子的年长者哽咽道歉，陌生人与邻居的声音交织，构成一份关于社会不平等与暴力循环的声音文献。录音保留了街道、蚊虫、流浪狗等环境音，未经任何音乐后期处理。收益将捐赠给反暴力公益组织。这是一次社会声音档案式的记录，介于田野录音与口述历史之间。

items.body: Review by CeeJayGee — I first discovered The Tangent 15 years ago, but it took me another couple of years to realise how good their music is. For a few years they were one of a handful of bands that I would call my favourites. The quality of the albums over the last few years has been so high that I would now say The Tangent is my favourite and most listened to band. I also appreciate being able to engage with Andie Tillison via social media. After I commented on the quality of this year's Po90 release, aftersometimelater, saying that it deserved to be more heavily marketed to raise its profile, Andie asked me whether I would like to hear some of the forthcoming album, Was. I jumped at the opportunity. I thought I would hear just a couple of tracks but over several weeks I was able to listen to and comment on the entire album. The album tells Andie's story through the music and the events that have shaped his own musical career. You could call it autobiographical. I don't believe anyone has attempted this previously and the purpose of the album has clearly inspired Andie to create some wonderful melodies.The first track I heard was the title track which I found immediately likeable and kept playing on repeat. I loved the simplicity of the riff which develops through the 22 minutes of the track. I couldn't stop playing it after the first listen. I then heard the Was Suite which at over 53 minutes is structured as six named segments that flow perfectly from one to another on the album. In classical music they would be called movements. When I first heard it, it was a single track. This is a largely instrumental piece and my past interest in classical music, and my love of rock and jazz fusion, makes this compulsive listening. The final segment, titled "Let Me Sing", is Andie sharing how he communicates through his music and his messages through poetic lyrics. It is a powerful conclusion which finishes with an inspirational speaker advising a young audience how to have good lives. I then heard Was Not, which Andie indicated to me was his favourite. This is another complex 20 minute plus and certainly matches Was and the Suite in terms of quality. The track opens with Andie's impressions of World War II formed from what he learned from the people who lived through and survived it, and the many films and TV series which his family watched together in his youth. I am a bit older than Andie, but I can empathise with this totally. The track develops with memories of further events and the hope that the World would learn from its past mistakes. He continues that the horrors we all see through the media seem to make us numb and he concludes with a very personal memory of his father in a nursing home. It is an extraordinary piece. The underlying themes and melodies are most enjoyable, but the piece is dominated by the message. For me, these are three standout pieces of music and these tracks are destined to be classics. The album also includes Follow The River plus four bonus tracks (two of which are around 20 minutes long) which are all enjoyable. I have little doubt that this will be my favourite 2026 album and it is likely to end up being my favourite album by The Tangent (so far).
items._genre: eclectic prog / progressive rock / classical fusion
items._cn_summary: The Tangent 新专辑《Was》是一部自传体式的长篇前卫摇滚作品，以超过50分钟的Was Suite为核心，通过六个乐章式段落串联主创Andie的音乐生涯与个人记忆。标题曲以简洁的riff动机发展延伸至22分钟，展现出渐进式编曲的耐心。Was Not以二战叙事为引子，结合家族影视记忆与父亲在养老院的私人片段，音乐服务于叙事而非反之。整体偏向经典交响前卫摇滚传统，融入摇滚、爵士融合与古典音乐元素，旋律驱动型编曲为主。评论文本质上为乐迷推荐型长文，缺乏对音乐技法与声响设计的深入剖析，且文本因个人情感叙述较长导致信息密度不均。该作品虽有爵士融合跨界成分，但整体仍属传统prog摇滚范畴，与用户偏好的实验前卫、自由即兴、电子声响设计等方向存在较大距离。

items.body: Review by siLLy puPPy — Touted as the French female fronted version of Porcupine Tree, the Brittany based DELUSION SQUAREDemerged in 2009 as a band that delivered much more than being a mere Steven Wilson clone. A meretrio with a larger than life sound the band was initiated by bassist / keyboardist Emmanuel de SaintM�en and multi-instrumentalist Steven Francis who would hook up with guitarist and vocalist LorraineYoung and crank out a trilogy of sci-fi themed concept albums that explored all the good BladeRunner-esque dystopia and control systems of power structures. The band released three albums withYoung who would move on before the fourth and final release came out in 2018.The band's self-titled debut and first album of the trilogy delivered an album's worth of mindbending paranoia as it incorporates the story-telling narratives inspired by neo-prog acts such asPendragon, IQ and Arena although the alternative heavy rock guitar does indeed derive inspirationfrom the prog alt rock of Porcupine Tree's early 2000s works. The music while rooted in accessibleinstantly addictive melodies also offers a grunge-fueled guitar heft that gracefully melds theworlds of smooth atmospheric embellishments with a grittier guitar gusto. While the PT referencesget tossed around quite a bit, to my ears the band at this stage reminds me more of an accessiblecrossover version of Thinking Plague if that band had eschewed the jagged angularities of avant-progand focused more on pop hooks.The album of 11 tracks is nicely spanned out with interesting intros that introduces delicate piano-based hooks and tender, even fragile sounding vocals that contrast starkly with the alternative rockon the verge of becoming metal guitar chords and riffing sessions. On the production side the albumis both smoothly polished as well as offering a nice grating edge that keeps it on both sides of thefence simultaneously in a rather elegant fashion. The tracks vary sufficiently to keep the interestlevel up and although the album sounds a little generic with the opening "The Very Day," it doesn'ttake long for its charm to burrow into your psyche and let you acclimate rather quickly into thesubtle differences that point to varying influences but sound distant enough to offer a fresh spinon the more modern take on the alt heavy rock shtick.It's actually a very pleasant mix by merging the worlds of the hard alternative rock of PorcupineTree alone with the narrative layout of neo-prog acts along with the accompanying atmospheric andkeyboard prowess. Both aspects really hold up well and despite being only a trio, the members playmultiple instruments offering a much larger band sound. Add to that the Muse inspired topics ofconspiracy, crimes against humanity and secret projects and it doesn't take long to get sucked intothe mix of it all. While lyrics rarely appeal to me, i have say that DELUSION SQUARED's debutdelivered a nicely balanced album where themes, lyrics, instrumentation and production all cometogether in a unique yet familiar manner and performed quite well by the musicians without losingthat laid back charm even when rocking the house.
items._cn_summary: Delusion Squared的首张专辑是一张以科幻为主题的概念专辑，由法国布列塔尼地区的三人乐队完成。作品以键盘、贝斯和多乐器演奏为基础，融合了Porcupine Tree式另类摇滚的吉他厚重感与neo-prog乐队的叙事结构，钢琴开场的细腻旋律与近乎金属化的失真riff形成鲜明对比。制作上兼顾光滑打磨与粗糙质感，十一首曲目风格变化丰富，开篇略显平淡但很快展现出层次。歌词涉及阴谋、反人类罪行与秘密计划等题材，与音乐的氛围营造相辅相成。整体而言，这是一张在另类摇滚与新派前卫之间寻找平衡的作品，旋律可听性强但实验性有限。

Watch TAZER’s ‘Rest in Beatz’ video Hellektrokution Records describes the track as “built around driving electronic rhythms, distorted synthesizers and an intense industrial atmosphere.” “Rest in Beatz” is also streaming on Spotify. About TAZER TAZER is a Norwegian electro-industrial trio made up of Calico InHell, Drumnibal and Oni X01, who record under the aliases CALICO, DRUMNIBAL and ONI-X01. The project formed in 2024 around the EP “9001 Volts” and issued its debut single, “A Razor Can Slit, A Tazer Can Kill”, in November 2024. TAZER returned in October 2025 with a video for “I Put a Spell on You” for Halloween. Five further tracks written over the following two years joined five songs from “9001 Volts” to form the ten-track debut album “Taze Is The Rule,” released through Hellektrokution Records on 30 April 2026. The label followed it with the single “Raise The Voltage” in May 2026. In an August 2026 Side-Line interview, Oni X01 said “Taze Is The Rule” is “our manifesto, our creed, and our undeniable truth,” and described the album’s sound as a mix of metal and EBM elements influenced by Rammstein and Combichrist. “Rest in Beatz” is TAZER’s newest single and video, released now on Hellektrokution Records.

items.body: Review by Thomas1969 — Every time Steven Wilson releases a new album, I think: "Wow, is it that time again?" It also occurs to me that I rarely revisit the albums released after *Hand. Cannot. Erase.* (2015). While every album since then has certainly contained good songs, none have gripped me the way the dark *Grace for Drowning* (2011), *The Raven That Refused to Sing (And Other Stories)* (2013), and the aforementioned album did.What I've missed since then is a certain emotional depth in the music, as well as that "moody" side. Fortunately, we hear that moody side return in the advance track "Requiem for a Village," taken from the album of the same name due out in November. The album cover certainly looks promising. But what about the content?the music itself? "Requiem for a Village" is vintage Wilson: a moody opening, an enigmatic progression, a guitar eruption three-quarters of the way through, busy drumming, and?this is where the real tension lies for me?the quieter passages and mysterious vocals (Wilson is singing more beautifully than ever) at the beginning and end, accompanied by evocative keyboard sounds.Of course, there is a full band behind Steven Wilson?it could easily be called the Steven Wilson Band. Who makes up the band as of 2026? Lead vocals, bass guitar, guitar, Mellotron, keyboards, percussion, piano, oboe, mixing engineer, lyre, producer: Steven WilsonGuitar, backing vocals, synthesizer, Mellotron, co-producer, lyre: Randy McStineDrums: Russell HolzmanSo, it is very much a Steven Wilson affair, but Randy McStine and?most certainly?the new drummer Russell Holzman deserve special mention. They play skillfully?you have to hand it to them?but does it truly *connect*? Does it move me? Richard Barbieri moved me with every keystroke; of that, I remain absolutely certain. I am also left with a nagging feeling?since a new The Pineapple Thief album is coming out next month as well?of whether I am looking forward more to *that* album (featuring Gavin Harrison on drums) or to the new Steven Wilson release. You might say: you still miss Porcupine Tree. That's true. You never really get over that. But what I miss most is the emotional depth found in Porcupine Tree's music. Since *Hand. Cannot. Erase.*, no full Steven Wilson album has truly moved me in the same way. That could change. It might... You probably grasp my point. My ambivalence.A bit of a mixed bag, then, this sprawling track?clocking in at 7 minutes and 56 seconds.
items._genre: crossover prog / art rock / moody prog
items._cn_summary: Steven Wilson 新作以单曲形式先行释出，延续其标志性的阴郁氛围：开场铺陈低沉神秘，键盘声景营造出悬疑感，中段吉他爆发与密集鼓点形成张力，前后两端则以轻柔人声收束。乐队编制由 Wilson 本人多面手身份主导，辅以 Randy McStine 与新任鼓手 Russell Holzman，乐手技术扎实但评论者感到情感连接不足。整体风格横跨前卫摇滚与艺术摇滚领域，编制与制作精致，却偏向内省而非实验突破。评论者对作品抱有矛盾心态——承认其氛围营造的功力，却也坦承自《Hand. Cannot. Erase.》以来未能找到昔日的情感深度，甚至流露出对 Gavin Harrison 时期与 Porcupine Tree 时代的怀念。

It is the first new music from the darkwave and goth act since their 2024 album “Exodus”. items.body: Clan of Xymox released the double A-side single “Broken Heart” / “Fire” on 23 September 2026 through Metropolis Records in North and South America and Trisol in Europe. It is the first new music from the darkwave and goth act since their 2024 album “Exodus”. Broken Heart / Fire by Clan of Xymox Clan of Xymox co-founder and frontman Ronny Moorings describes “Broken Heart” as “a journey through heartbreak, desire and emotional combustion.” Built on layered synth lines and a steady mid-tempo pulse, the track pairs Moorings’ vocal with lyrics about a relationship that will not fully end; his aim, he says, was “to capture the tension between losing someone and still being consumed by them.” A music video for “Broken Heart” is scheduled to go online later on 25 September, at 6pm UK time (7pm CET). No further details on “Fire”, the single’s second A-side track, were provided beyond its inclusion alongside “Broken Heart”. The single arrives as Clan of Xymox continue a run of live dates through the end of 2026, including main-stage slots at WGT-Leipzig and M’era Luna earlier in the year. Upcoming shows run from Italy in early October through Germany, Austria, Hungary, Croatia, Spain, Poland and France in November and December: 2 October – Traffic Club, Rome, Italy 3 October – Lizard Club, Naples, Italy 7 November – Gleis 9, Bochum, Germany 10 November – Strom, Munich, Germany 11 November – Chelsea, Vienna, Austria 12 November – A38, Budapest, Hungary 13 November – Culture Factory, Zagreb, Croatia 21 November – Sala Jerusalem, Valencia, Spain 27 November – Klub CK Wiatrak, Zabrze, Poland 5 December – La Laiterie, Strasbourg, France About Clan of Xymox Clan of Xymox formed in Nijmegen, the Netherlands, in 1982, when Ronny Moorings and Anka Wolbert began writing together as students. The pair relocated to Amsterdam and were joined by Pieter Nooten, and the group signed to the British label 4AD in 1985, releasing their self-titled debut album that year and “Medusa” in 1986. Their atmospheric, synth-driven post-punk sound built a cult following across the UK and mainland Europe during this period. The band moved to PolyGram’s Wing Records for “Twist of Shadows” (1989) and “Phoenix” (1991), shifting toward a more commercial synth-pop direction that incorporated alternative dance elements and brought them US chart exposure. Nooten and Wolbert left after “Phoenix”, and Moorings continued as the band’s sole constant songwriter through a run of independent releases in the early-to-mid 1990s. The group signed to Metropolis Records in North America in 1997 and to Trisol Music Group for European releases from 2009, distribution deals the band has kept ever since. The resurgence of interest in gothic and electro-industrial rock through the 1990s and 2000s gave Clan of Xymox a renewed audience, and the band has maintained a steady release and touring schedule in the decades since. Their most recent studio album, “Exodus”, arrived in mid-2024, followed by the “Blood of Christ” EP later that year and a 3CD edition of “Exodus” in early 2025. The band’s current touring line-up includes Moorings alongside Mojca Zugna, Mario Usai and Sean Winzer. “Broken Heart” / “Fire” is the group’s first new material since that run of 2024 and 2025 releases, and arrives alongside a fresh round of European festival and club dates through the end of 2026.

items.body: Conscience, the German electropop and synthpop project of Rüdiger Illg, releases the compilation “Uncharted Vol. 1 (The Singles 2009-2023)” on Echozone on 25 September 2026. It gathers Conscience’s single releases from that period into one set, adds one new song and three new mixes, and presents every track remastered. The label describes a second volume, “Uncharted Vol. 2”, as already in the works. Despite the plural billing Echozone sometimes gives the project, Conscience remains a one-man operation: Illg writes, plays and produces every track himself at Science2, his home studio in Leeste, Lower Saxony. He formed Conscience in 1991, but “Uncharted Vol. 1” starts its clock at 2009, not at the project’s founding. Echozone explains why: Conscience did not sign a record deal until 1998, with the “Hardware” EP, and that contract proved short-lived. Illg then signed to Echozone, whose own account of the compilation dates that move to around 2008, when “Theatre Of Deception” served as the lead single for the album “Gravity Has Gone”; Side-Line’s earlier research into the project’s Echozone catalogue had put that signing a year later, in 2009. Physical releases stopped soon after over cost, and for years Conscience issued albums and EPs with no accompanying singles at all. That changed with the 2020 album “Sentient”, after which every Conscience album has carried multiple single releases, the run “Uncharted Vol. 1” now compiles. The compilation follows the single “Explain Everything”, which Echozone issued on 28 August 2026 as an advance taste of the same collection. About Conscience Rüdiger Illg founded Conscience in August 1991, working first with a single Yamaha SY22 synthesizer, and has written, played and produced every track since under that name at Science2. He also records as Science O.C.N. and Chaos Network. The project’s first six years produced cassette-only releases traded through the tape network, followed by a first CD in 1998 and a run of CD-Rs through the early 2000s. NewEx Records picked up Conscience in 2007, and Illg signed to Echozone in 2009, a relationship that has produced the bulk of the catalogue since, including the albums “Phases³” (2025) and “Suspended In Time” (2026) and the singles and EPs “Uncharted Vol. 1” now draws its selections from. Guest vocalists across the catalogue have included Colin Angus of The Shamen and Dan Söderqvist of Twice a Man. “Uncharted Vol. 1 (The Singles 2009-2023)” is Conscience’s first compilation to collect that stretch of the catalogue in one release, with a second volume already planned.

items.body: Front Line Assembly released their eighth studio album, “Hard Wired,” through Off Beat on 25 September 1995, with Metropolis Records handling North America and Energy Rekords issuing the record in Sweden. It was the Canadian electro-industrial band’s first release for the German label. The album turns 31 this year. Bill Leeb and Rhys Fulber produced the record and wrote all ten tracks, which run 62 minutes: “Neologic Spasm,” “Paralyzed,” “Re-Birth,” “Circuitry,” “Mortal” (instrumental), “Modus Operandi,” “Transparent Species,” “Barcode,” “Condemned” and “Infra Red Combat.” Greg Reely engineered and mixed, with Delwyn Brooks assisting, continuing a working partnership that began on “Caustic Grip” in 1990. Devin Townsend played electric guitar, returning after his session work on the previous year’s “Millennium.” Dave McKean produced the illustration, design and photography. The sessions ran roughly five months at the Warehouse. Leeb wrote the lyrics only once the music was finished, and described that order as the band’s normal method rather than a choice made for this record: “We write […] the music and then once we’ve got it finished, then I sit at home and start on the lyrics. I can’t imagine writing any other way. […] I think with our music it’s usually the sounds that inspire us.” On what those lyrics deal with, he set materialism and environmental collapse against the technology driving both: “I think most of the lyrics are basically about man versus technology. Basically, we’re destroying our planet with technology. At the same time, technology is the only thing that can save us. It’s this constant struggle between these two forces that is making us go in whatever direction we’re all going.” That reading runs through the sampling as well. The album draws audio from “True Romance,” “In the Mouth of Madness,” “Lifeforce,” “Stargate,” “Speed,” “The Puppet Masters,” “No Escape,” “Romeo Is Bleeding,” “The Crow,” “Lethal Weapon” and “Alien 3,” alongside sound effects from the 1993 video game “Doom” and passages from three Aphex Twin recordings. “Circuitry” was the album’s only single, released on 31 October 1995. Its limited edition came as a two-CD digipak with remixes by Haujobb and Biosphere, a mixed-mode first disc carrying the “Millennium” video and photo galleries, and a second disc with the non-album tracks “Destructive Transformation” and “Hydrogen.” The album reached number 47 on the Swedish albums chart and the single number 32 on the Swedish singles chart. “Hard Wired” has sold at least 50,000 copies worldwide, and its 5,000-copy limited edition sold out in two weeks. A further track from the same sessions, “Plasticity,” was held back and issued separately; Fulber explained the decision in commercial terms: “We kept it off the album to release later […] It gives people a reason to check it out because if you release it as a single that is already on album no one is really going to care.” The “Plasticity” video won Best Alternative Video at the MuchMusic Video Awards in Toronto in 1996. The album has returned to shelves twice since. Black Rain Records pressed a 500-copy picture vinyl in August 2011, cut to seven songs, dropping “Mortal,” “Modus Operandi” and “Transparent Species.” For the record’s twentieth year, Artoffact Records issued a 300-copy vinyl box in 2015 pairing the album with the “Live Wired” live record and the “Circuitry” single, all remastered by Reely; Side-Line reported that The Front Line Assembly 6LP boxset ‘Hard Wired’ is almost sold out that May, and covered the same year’s news that Front Line Assembly finally see ‘Plasticity’ released on a 10 inch vinyl (3 formats). “Hard Wired” streams on Spotify. About Front Line Assembly Bill Leeb formed Front Line Assembly in Vancouver, Canada, in 1986, shortly after leaving Skinny Puppy, where he had contributed bass synth and backing vocals between 1985 and 1986 under the name Wilhelm Schroeder. He picked the band name to reflect his view that strength lies in working together. The demo tapes “Nerve War” and “Total Terror” were limited to 100 copies each and mostly passed around among friends, with Rhys Fulber contributing as an unofficial member. The project’s first appearance on record was “Aggression,” on the 1987 Third Mind compilation “For Your Ears Only.” Belgian label KK issued the debut album “The Initial Command” at the end of 1987, with Fulber and Michael Balch assisting, and German label Dossier released “State of Mind” in January 1988. When a planned Nettwerk release fell through, Third Mind put out “Corrosion” and the “Disorder” EP later that year, then signed the band to a three-album deal and licensed “Corrosion” to Wax Trax! for North America. Balch became an official member in 1988 and left after the 1989 “Gashed Senses & Crossfire” tour to join Ministry and Revolting Cocks. Fulber replaced him and appeared on “Caustic Grip” (1990), the album that started the band’s long partnership with engineer Greg Reely and introduced guitar on “Provision” and “Resist.” Chris Peterson debuted as live percussionist on the tour that followed in early 1991. “Tactical Neural Implant” (1992) turned toward more melodic, multi-layered arrangements and the heavy film sampling that became a fixture of the sound. Five remixes for Fear Factory’s “Fear Is the Mindkiller” EP in 1993 fed directly into “Millennium” (1994), the band’s first industrial metal record, built on metal guitar samples and Devin Townsend’s session work. “Hard Wired” arrived the following September. Fulber left in 1997 to concentrate on production, and Peterson took his place for “FLAvour of the Weak” (1997), “Implode” (1999) and “Epitaph” (2001), a run that traded the metal influences for breakbeat and big beat. Fulber returned for “Civilization” (2004), and Peterson rejoined for “Artificial Soldier” (2006), the first album to feature Jeremy Inkel and Jared Slingerland. “Improvised Electronic Device” (2010), “Echogenetic” (2013), “Wake Up the Coma” (2019) and “Mechanical Soul” (2021) followed, the last on Metropolis. The band also composed soundtracks for the games “Quake III: Team Arena,” “AirMech” and “WarMech.” Inkel died on 23 January 2018 at the age of 34, from complications of an asthma condition. Leeb has run Delerium since 1987 and Noise Unit since the late 1980s, while Fulber started Conjure One after his 1997 departure and has worked with Fear Factory for decades; Side-Line published a Front Line Assembly interview – Catching up with Bill Leeb and Rhys Fulber in 2024. “Hard Wired” turns 31 this year, the record that closed out the guitar-driven stretch the band opened with “Millennium” before the electronics took over again.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章是Side-Line发表的纪念性回顾文章，介绍Front Line Assembly 1995年发行的第八张录音室专辑《Hard Wired》迎来31周年。内容侧重于事实层面的档案梳理：唱片发行厂牌（Off Beat / Metropolis / Energy Rekords）、制作团队（Bill Leeb与Rhys Fulber创作、Greg Reely混音、Devin Townsend担任吉他客席）、十首曲目列表、采样来源（大量好莱坞电影配乐与Aphex Twin片段），以及瑞典榜单成绩。Leeb在采访中阐述创作顺序为'先曲后词'，并提及歌词主题围绕技术与人性的对立。关于音乐本身的分析极为有限，未涉及声音设计、节奏结构或与同类型作品的具体比较。整体偏向新闻性信息汇总而非深度乐评，对电子工业这一领域的爱好者有一定参考价值，但缺乏艺术层面的深入探讨。

items.body: Gang of Four, the English post-punk band from Leeds, released their debut album “Entertainment!” on 25 September 1979 through EMI, with Warner Bros. Records handling North America. The album turns 47 this year. It runs 39 minutes and 53 seconds across twelve tracks and was recorded that same year at The Workhouse on the Old Kent Road in London. Jon King and Andy Gill produced it with the band’s then-manager Rob Warr, and Rik Walton engineered. The line-up was King on lead vocals, percussion and melodica, Gill on electric guitar and vocals, Dave Allen on bass and Hugo Burnham on drums. EMI had signed the group after its debut release, the three-track “Damaged Goods” EP, issued on 13 October 1978 by Bob Last’s Edinburgh label Fast Product and recorded at Cargo Studios in Rochdale. Two of those three tracks, “Damaged Goods” and “Love Like Anthrax”, were re-recorded for the album. The running order is “Ether”, “Natural’s Not in It”, “Not Great Men”, “Damaged Goods”, “Return the Gift”, “Guns Before Butter”, “I Found That Essence Rare”, “Glass”, “Contract”, “At Home He’s a Tourist”, “5.45” and “Love Like Anthrax”. King wrote the lyrics under the influence of Situationism, the writing of Michel Foucault and Jacques Lacan, feminism and Marx’s theory of alienation. He also designed the sleeve, which reproduces a still from a Winnetou film in three processed versions, with a text reading: “The Indian smiles, he thinks that the cowboy is his friend. The cowboy smiles, he is glad the Indian is fooled. Now he can exploit him.” “At Home He’s a Tourist” reached number 58 in the UK Singles Chart, still the highest placing of any Gang of Four song. The band were booked to perform it on Top of the Pops, but the producers asked them to change the line “and the rubbers you hide in your top left pocket” to “rubbish”; the group refused and the appearance was cancelled. The album peaked at number 45 on the UK Albums Chart and number 35 in New Zealand. Writing in Rolling Stone in August 1980, David Fricke called it “the best debut album by a British band – punk or otherwise – since the original English release of The Clash”. About Gang of Four Gang of Four formed in Leeds in 1976 around guitarist Andy Gill and singer Jon King, who had met as students. Drummer Hugo Burnham and bassist Dave Wolfson completed the first line-up; after two or three gigs Wolfson was replaced by Dave Allen in 1977. Fast Product released the “Damaged Goods” EP in October 1978, and EMI signed the band the following year. “Entertainment!” arrived in September 1979 and was followed by “Solid Gold” in March 1981 and “Songs of the Free” in 1982, the latter carrying “I Love a Man in Uniform”, which was dropped from BBC playlists during the Falklands conflict. Allen left in 1981 after two albums and went on to co-found Shriekback; Busta “Cherry” Jones filled in before Sara Lee joined as the permanent bassist. Burnham left in 1982 and Steve Goulding took over the drum stool for “Hard” (1983). The band split in 1984. Gill and King reconvened three times in the 1990s, recording “Mall” (1991) with Gail Ann Dorsey on bass and “Shrinkwrapped” (1995). The founding four reunited in 2004 and toured the UK in 2005, releasing the re-recorded “Return the Gift” on 28 September 2005 and performing “Entertainment!” in full for the All Tomorrow’s Parties Don’t Look Back series that year; Side-Line covered the band’s later live material in Exclusive preview Gang Of Four’s ‘Live…In The Moment’ live album. Burnham departed again in late 2005 to return to teaching, and Allen was replaced by Thomas McNeice in 2008. King left in 2011 after disagreements with Gill, and John Sterry took over vocals. That line-up issued “Content” (2011), “What Happens Next” (2015) and “Happy Now” (2019). Andy Gill died on 1 February 2020, aged 64, ending that incarnation of the band. In October 2021 King reformed Gang of Four with Burnham, Sara Lee and Slint guitarist David Pajo for a tour of 1977 to 1983 material. Lee was replaced by Linda Pardee in January 2024 and then by Gail Greenwood that July, and Pajo by Ted Leo in January 2025. Dave Allen died in April 2025, aged 69, having lived with early-onset dementia. The band played its final show in Amsterdam on 6 July 2025. The record’s reach outlasted the band. Die Krupps recorded a version of “To Hell With Poverty” for their 2021 covers album, as reported in Die Krupps cover Gang Of Four with new single ‘To Hell With Poverty’. Michael Stipe has said of the band: “Gang of Four could really swing. I stole a lot from them.” Rolling Stone placed “Entertainment!” at number 490 on its 500 Greatest Albums list in 2003, number 483 in 2012 and number 273 in 2020, and Kevin J. H. Dettmar wrote a book on it for the 33 1/3 series in 2014. Forty-seven years on, the debut remains the album on which the Leeds four-piece set its guitar, bass and drums against lyrics about commodities, contracts and the news.
items._cn_summary: 本文是对Gang of Four首张专辑《Entertainment!》47周年纪念的回顾性资讯，介绍了专辑的录制背景、成员构成、曲目顺序及厂牌发行细节。Jon King的歌词创作深受情境主义、福柯、拉康、马克思异化理论及女性主义影响，展现了乐队的智识倾向。Andy Gill的吉他以干硬、去旋律化的riff和失谐音色著称，摒弃传统摇滚的炫技，呈现一种功能化、节奏化的处理方式，与鼓击的强力碰撞构建出冷峻的张力。封套设计引用西部片剧照，以图像讽刺消费主义与权力剥削，与唱片内在批判性形成呼应。文章更多是事实梳理而非深度乐评，缺乏对声音设计、节奏语言、录制美学的深入分析，信息偏向档案性质。

items.body: Rammstein‘s “Herzeleid” turns 31 this year. Motor Music released the debut studio album by the Berlin Neue Deutsche Härte and industrial metal band on 25 September 1995. Producer Jacob Hellner oversaw the sessions at Polar Studios and his own BomKrash studio in Stockholm, Sweden, with Dutch engineer Ronald Prent mixing. “Herzeleid” runs eleven tracks and 49:22, all written by the band. The tracklist comprises “Wollt ihr das Bett in Flammen sehen”, “Der Meister”, “Weißes Fleisch”, “Asche zu Asche”, “Seemann”, “Du riechst so gut”, “Das alte Leid”, “Heirate mich”, “Herzeleid”, “Laichzeit” and “Rammstein”. Till Lindemann sang lead, with Richard Kruspe and Paul Landers on guitars, Oliver Riedel on bass, Christoph Schneider on drums and Christian “Flake” Lorenz on keyboards. “Du riechst so gut” preceded the album as its first single on 28 August 1995, followed by “Seemann” on 8 January 1996. The album initially sold slowly but climbed to No. 2 on the German Albums Chart on the strength of the band’s touring, and was later certified 2× Platinum in Germany. A remastered anniversary edition followed on 4 December 2020, released both digitally and on double heavyweight colored vinyl. About Rammstein Rammstein formed in Berlin in 1994. Guitarist Richard Kruspe, who had relocated from East to West Berlin in 1989 and played in the band Orgasm Death Gimmick, began working with bassist Oliver Riedel and drummer Christoph Schneider in 1993. Kruspe recruited vocalist Till Lindemann, then a basket weaver and drummer in the band First Arsch, after overhearing him sing. The group entered and won a 1994 Berlin contest for amateur bands, receiving a week of professional studio time; their winning demo drew guitarist Paul Landers into the project, and Landers in turn brought in keyboardist Christian “Flake” Lorenz from Feeling B, completing the six-piece lineup that has remained unchanged since. The band signed to Motor Music and began recording its debut album, “Herzeleid”, in March 1995 with producer Jacob Hellner, who would go on to produce five more Rammstein albums through 2009. “Du riechst so gut” appeared as the lead single that August, and “Herzeleid” followed on 25 September 1995. Rammstein spent the rest of 1995 opening for Project Pitchfork and Clawfinger before headlining their own German tour that December, building the live following that carried the album to eventual gold and platinum status. The band’s second album, “Sehnsucht” (1997), debuted at No. 1 in Germany and produced the singles “Engel” and “Du hast”, followed by the live album “Live aus Berlin” (1999). Rammstein signed with Universal Music and released “Mutter” in 2001, then “Reise, Reise” (2004) and “Rosenrot” (2005), each reaching the top of album charts across Europe. “Liebe ist für alle da” (2009) gave the band its first German No. 1 single with “Pussy”. After a recording hiatus spent touring, Rammstein released an untitled seventh album in 2019, which reached No. 1 in fourteen countries, followed by “Zeit” in 2022. On the 25th anniversary of “Herzeleid” in September 2020, the band announced the remastered anniversary edition of the album, released that December. “Herzeleid” remains Rammstein’s debut record and, thirty-one years on, the release that introduced the band’s sound and lineup essentially unchanged to today.

items.body: Top PickThe Ocean – Solaris (progressive post-metal) Eden should be along with a proper review sometime in the near future, but it's safe to say this first outing from the new Ocean line-up is not only a bona fide success, but also stands out as one of their strongest albums to date. The jump in quality might not come as a surprise after the snoozefest that was Holoxene (2023), but there's an argument to be made that this is the best Ocean album since genuine GOAT-contender Pelagial (2013), or even outside of it.At well over an hour and with songs and song-suites pushing the ten, fifteen and even twenty-minute mark, Solaris can be a tall order. Likewise, its expansive and layered composition works best when played in full and paying it complete attention, which is probably why I haven't listened to it nearly as much as I should have, even though we've had the promo for a month or so now. Rest assured though, that this is an album I will be playing and referring back to for years to come, and I doubt I'm alone in that assessment. Solaris by The Ocean Last Week's Most Unjustifiably Overlooked ReleaseUncle Acid and the Deadbeats – Shapes of Midnight (occult rock/metal)I didn't give this one a proper listen before posting last week's roundup, we got the promo early, but, after a quick sample I wrote it off as a good album from a band I respected but traditionally Wasn't For Me™. I should have paid more heed to Jordan's review though, because—while I'm not qualified to comment on whether this is the best Uncle Acid and the Deadbeats album—I can say its doing a whole lot more for me than any of their previous records have, or similar releases of its ilk have been lately.In comparison to the shark-jumping self-parody of the new Green Lung record, Shapes of Midnight oozes class and sincerity, along with a compelling mastery of its craft. It also rocks super hard. Along with the expected malaize of psychedelic Black Sabbath worship that pervades their sound, "Psycho on the Loose" sounds like Turbonegro covering Turbo-era Judas Priest, while "Don't Let it Control You" almost sounds like Motorhead mixed with Hellhammer, with lots of bass fills that bring to mind "Born to Be Wild". Indeed, bassist Justin Smith may well be the man of the match, delivering a Meddle-esque Pink Floyd trudge on "When Evil Wakes" and plenty of Geezer Butler-isms throughout that help make Shapes of Midnight a surprisingly vital pre-summer soundtrack as the weather starts to get warmer down under. items._cn_summary: 本文为多张专辑的发行汇总评论，重点推介其新阵容首张专辑。该专辑被描述为渐进后金属风格，歌曲时长普遍在十至二十分钟之间，编曲层次丰富、篇幅宏大，需要完整专注聆听。评论认为这是乐队自被视为巅峰之作以来的最强专辑之一。另有一张神秘主义摇滚专辑获得高度评价，其风格融合了迷幻黑色安息日式的氛围与硬摇滚能量，贝斯线条尤为突出。汇总部分还提及多张风格各异的金属类专辑，但缺乏深入评述。整体内容以传统金属子类型为主，评论质量中规中矩，信息量有限。

items._cn_summary: 尼日利亚歌手艾拉·斯塔的第三张专辑在她迁居纽约后发行，是一张以非洲流行乐为骨架、广泛融合多种舞曲元素的多元化作品。曲目涉及使用Wyclef Jean采样的哀愁非洲节奏、拉丁系深屋、中东风味的舞蹈厅、与莱昂·托马斯合作的合成器放克，以及与泽恩合作的钢琴抒情曲。贯穿整张专辑的是歌手充满律动感的低沉嗓音，其音色能够自然贴合各种曲风。评论认为这张专辑在体现艺人当前上升势头的同时，也展示了其作为非洲流行乐新一代代表的多面性与掌控力。

items._cn_summary: 这是一张由贝斯手须川崇志领衔的钢琴三重奏专辑，成员包括钢琴家林正樹和鼓手石若駿。乐评强调三人的欧洲巡演经历提升了乐团的国际声誉。林正樹以剧伴和独奏作品闻名，其旋律被描述为时而映照优美景象，时而自由翱翔于空中并发生奇妙变化。石若駿的鼓击在细腻表达与释放能量之间切换，以其从富士摇滚到红白歌合战的多领域活跃著称。须川的贝斯以深沉共鸣和丰富音色被形容为将音乐导向理想之乡。文末以推广性语言呼吁读者不要错过这张新作。整体为传统钢琴三重奏框架内的当代爵士演奏，未涉及明显实验或前卫元素。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. items._cn_summary: 这是一张以人声与钢琴为核心的爱丁堡植物园驻地艺术作品，源自苏格兰民谣创作歌手与声音设计师七年合作的结晶。专辑以园中最古老的棕榈树被砍伐为引子，从一棵树的历史延伸至自然、时间与人类记忆的宏大叙事。制作上保持极度克制，钢琴与人声占据主导，仅辅以精心铺设的环境声响设计，整体呈现出冥想式的氛围质感。重复的旋律短语在文本与音乐中形成回旋结构，使听众成为旅程的参与者。专辑的结尾揭示了一个反讽：被认定为百慕大棕榈的树种其实是墨西哥棕榈，而新苗将在旧树的位置继续生长。整体音乐语言温和而内省，融合了苏格兰民谣传统与跨学科艺术思维，但实验性元素较为有限。

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑记录了Dr. John在德国洛蕾莱露天剧场的演出，乐队由吉他、贝斯和鼓组成紧凑四人编制，以新奥尔良传统为核心，融合R&B、放克和布鲁斯元素。曲目包括Mardi Gras经典'Iko Iko'、带有巫毒仪式感的'I Walk on Guilded Splinters'、Duke Ellington翻唱以及Earl King的'Big Chief'等。演出被定位为一场Mardi Gras风格的大杂烩，混合新奥尔良标准和作者本人代表作。文中提到Dr. John自称的'funknology'和巫毒咒语元素，加上迷幻吉他独奏和丛林咆哮音效，展现出一定的迷幻色彩。然而整体仍属传统美国南方音乐范畴，虽然世界音乐元素存在，但缺少实验性与前卫性，与用户偏好的实验、前卫、自由即兴方向距离较远。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — The passage of 30 years and a (duh, this is Polish neo prog after all) different vocalist notwithstanding, this reminds me of COLLAGE's classic "Moonshine" album, the one that still dwarfs most of the British giants. The problem is, it recalls the excesses of that masterpiece rather than its massive triumphs that inspired so much more from that country and beyond. Apparently conceived to lighten the mood amongst the lyrically downbeat sentiments of the reunion album "Over and Out" and to accompany it on the tour, "One and Only" should have been patterned after the sumptuous "Living in the Moonlight" rather than the bloated "In Your Eyes", which indeed means it's pretty good for the first half and abysmal for the home stretch. In the end, for a presumably lighter number, it's one of their most oppressive songs and I'd rather bathe in the tears of "What about the Pain (a family album)" a thousand times before I hear this again.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑被评价为波兰新前卫摇滚乐队2024年发行的单曲作品，主要作为前一张回归专辑巡演的补充。乐评认为其前半段尚可，后半段陷入冗长膨胀的编曲，整体氛围压抑而非原本设想的轻快感。评论者明确表示宁愿反复聆听乐队早期作品也不想再听这首单曲。配器与制作沿袭了乐队经典的交响化路线与复杂结构，但在创新性上被指为重复以往作品的问题，未能展现新的方向。作为偏主流的前卫摇滚分支，其编曲手法偏向传统，与实验性前卫或电子融合的审美距离较远。

items.body: Review by alainPP — Kimmo P'RSTI's fourth album is a symphonic folk-prog-country affair featuring inspiring guest appearances, an analog sound, and Kimmo battling AI. His style ranges from Genesis and Yes to Supertramp, Camel, and Caravan."Circle of Wagons" showcases a distinctive folk-prog universe, a medieval touch in neo-classical mode, and a solemn sound reminiscent of Camel'it's a given. The choir, the melody that evokes Unitopia, the Archangel, and the cinematic drift on the famous "Close Encounters of the Third Kind" are all present. The guitar solo adds a touch of nostalgia to the repetitive melody, and the outro flute hints at the arrival of the alien. "Carousel" features fruity guitar, swirling keyboards, and a vintage instrumental that flirts with the "dinosaur" aesthetic, a tribute to JP Boffo. "Nightmares Come to Consume" features a fruity and catchy saxophone riff, reminiscent of PANZERPAPPA, but with a touch more Phil COLLINS. The shunt is a highlight, while the chorus becomes repetitive. "Chasing Echoes" has an airy, western-tinged melancholy feel, with a melting intro that perfectly captures the current mood. The vintage organ amplifies the effect of this beautiful, plaintive ballad, with vocals provided by one of the four regular members on this otherwise conventional track. "Things Not Seen" has the sound of a CAMEL album; Risto's saxophone brightens the air, the symphonic keyboard drift flirts with TANGERINE DREAM, followed by a blazing guitar solo and a prominent bassline that grabs your attention. The track is a versatile, danceable pop gem."In My Life" follows in the same vein, with a guitar solo and a raspy vocal that amplify the depth of this AMBROSIA track. "Light of Other Days" opens with a 100% bucolic feel, featuring an enchanting marshmallow flute followed by a devastating pad. The mysterious keyboard draws the listener in; the perfect instrumental that takes you on a journey of no return. "You and the Sun" begins with a jazzy keyboard, followed by a dynamic atmosphere with a prog-metal riff. The vocals of one of the four guests might surprise with their diversity, their distinctiveness, I mean. The mid-track shift evokes "Canterbury" sounds, reminiscent of CARAVAN, with this delicate, understated, soulless yet meticulously crafted variation. "Over the Sleeping Stars" begins with a vibrant bassline and rhythmic percussion on Risto's saxophone. The guitar leads into a fresh, energetic, and catchy instrumental. A festive folk-jazzy vibe at the start, the guitar solo ignites the music; simple, effective, the outro too short to send you soaring into space. "Only One in the Crowd" is a jazz-rock track featuring bass and distinctive keyboards; the vocals add a prog edge. You have to wait for the transitions to truly appreciate the progressive influences, particularly the delicate keyboard solo. The brooding vocals lead into a bluesy guitar solo that we adore, the high notes keeping us on the edge of our seats. This is the album's highlight, showcasing masterful playing. "With a Breath, I Linger" begins with a pastoral flute over a minimalist piano chord. A slow, solemn, almost martial melody, with Hanna and Rafael at the helm, is the perfect way to close this album of concentrated musical notes.Kimmo P'RSTI is the same artist who played in SAMURAI OF PROG, THE GUILDMASTER, and also contributed to Rafael PACHA.

items.body: The funk Isaac Hayes and Willie Hutch wrote for American crime films in the early 1970s has a second home in Hamburg, a city whose funk scene runs through The Mighty Mocambos, Bacao Rhythm & Steel Band and the Légère Recordings label. The Winston Brothers come straight out of that scene, and “Get On Down” opens their second album, Sweets, out on 6 November via Ohio’s Colemine Records. It starts at full tempo: a hard breakbeat, choppy guitar chanks and a two-man horn section. Multi-instrumentalist and producer Sebastian Nagel and drummer Lucas Kochbeck formed the band as a school project, and Nagel describes the partnership in one line: “It’s a family thing, and we really know each other well.” Both play in Bacao, Nagel has also played with the Mocambos, and Kochbeck with Hamburg Spinners, part of a circuit where the same players keep turning up in each other’s line-ups. Sweets draws on that circuit, with Kimo Eiserbeck on saxophone and flute, Hans Stephan on trumpet and Carsten Meyer, the Hamburg keyboardist known as Erobique, on synths. Extra drums come from Max Weissenfeldt, once of Munich’s The Poets of Rhythm and now working as Max Whitefield. Sax and trumpet stick to short, angular stabs, the punctuating role horns play on the Hayes and Hutch scores. Midway the band drop into a dub-style section with delay on the instrumental parts, and the drums carry on underneath: like Drift, their 2022 debut, the track is built on the break. Stream “Get On Down” HERE and order Sweets ahead of release through THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: The Winston Brothers – Get On Down appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items.body: The Actions, a Bristol alt-electronic duo, released the single and video “Container” on 25 September 2026 through the Barcelona label No Where Records. The track is the first single from an album the duo have set for spring 2027, following their March 2026 single “Take More.” “Container” is also available to stream on Spotify. ‘Container’ marks The Actions’ first single since ‘Take More’ No Where Records describes “Container” as pushing the duo’s blend of “alternative electronics, dark textures and powerful songwriting” further than their previous single. The Actions describe themselves as an alt-electro-noise duo, and their recent work blends rock and electronic music with a punk-like directness, a shift they trace back to the March 2026 single “Take More.” About The Actions The Actions are a Bristol duo made up of Marta Argenio, who also performs as Silty, and Maurizio “Mo” Stellato. The pair share vocal, guitar and bass duties alongside electronics, exploring the space between rock and electronic music. Their debut album, “Flourish,” came out in 2021. The duo have previously opened for R.E.M., Green Day, Garbage and The Distillers, and earned airplay on BBC Radio 6 Music. The Actions returned in March 2026 with “Take More,” a three-track single pairing the original with a stripped-back “Flatland Mix” and a remix from IKO Twins, backed by a music video Mo edited through his own MStar Design work. The band said the record marked a turn toward something stronger and more direct than their earlier, more atmospheric work: “After our last, more transcendent record, we felt the urge to return with something stronger and more direct, and though it took time to get there, we knew this was the right moment to come back.” They called it “a song about growing up in the suburbs,” weighing whether to stay with the people they love or break away. The Actions joined No Where Records in July 2026. “Container” is the duo’s first release for the Barcelona label and the opening single from the album they have scheduled for spring 2027.

items.body: Review by Matti — Today is the official release date of the third album by Confusion Field, the Finnish heavy prog act sovereignly led by multi-instrumentalist, vocalist, composer and producer Tomi Kankainen. This time he plays himself all of the guitars as well, and the drums are now played by an Italian session drummer, Martino Malacrida. I have reviewed both of the earlier albums (dating from 2021 and 2023), and, given that I'm not an active listener or connoisseur of the heavier genres, I struggle a bit to find something new to say. But I certainly still feel Confusion Field makes "modern Finnish heavy prog at its best". If you have enjoyed CF before, you will have a great listening with this one too, or if you're new to the band, let's say that if you are into contemporary heavy/metal prog and bands such as Riverside and Porcupine Tree, you may be happily surprised. The moods are rather dark but not too depressive. The sound is very well produced and balanced. The guitars have the metallic bite but they don't go TOO far into aggressiveness for me to digest. The synths are incorporated into the meaty but clear texture, even though there may be slightly more of them than before. Malacrida is an excellent metal oriented drummer. No gun machine attacks but an intelligent sense of the whole. And what's best, Kankainen has an excellent voice quite comparable to Mariusz Duda of Riverside. This is something I cannot say very often within heavier end of prog. He never growls or yells at the top of his lungs and yet he has no difficulties whatsoever to convince the listener.The songs feel pretty tight at the average five minute length. All compositions sound fine and well crafted. Perhaps they aren't very distinctive from each other, in the progressive sense, but I don't get the feeling of tiresome sameness. The closing piece is the longest (7:16) and especially here the synths, a bit reminiscent of the mid-80's Simple Minds (Sparkle in the Rain, New Gold Dream), really make a nice extra dimension to the powerful soundscape. An album well worth checking out!

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由芬兰多乐器演奏家Tomi Kankainen主导，意大利客座鼓手Martino Malacrida参与录制，延续了乐队前两张作品所确立的现代芬兰重型前卫风格。整体制作精良，声音层次清晰，吉他带有金属质感但未过度激进，合成器融入厚重的音色织体中，为音乐增添了维度。人声部分表现突出，音色与Riverside主唱Mariusz Duda颇为接近，是该作品中较为亮眼的特点。歌曲长度大多控制在五分钟左右，结构紧凑，编曲考究，但各曲目之间的辨识度有限，缺少明显的前卫性突破。结尾曲篇幅最长，合成器部分带有八十年代中期Simple Minds的影子，与整体力量感十足的声景形成良好互补。对于偏好更实验性、更前卫或更具跨界融合色彩的音乐听众而言，这张专辑仍偏向传统重型前卫范式，与实验、爵士、电子、暗潮等领域的距离较远。

items.body: Mesh will release the mini-album “Fallen Angel” on Dependent Records on 27 November 2026. The British duo of Mark Hockings and Richard Silverthorn describe the nine-track record as an addendum to this year’s album “The Truth Doesn’t Matter” rather than the start of a new chapter, built from songs that grew out of writing sessions the pair started after touring behind that record. The label had asked for a fourth single from “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”; Hockings and Silverthorn instead wrote enough new material for close to half an album of additional songs. “Fallen Angel” combines four newly written tracks with remixes and a live recording, offering what the band calls a deeper dive into the themes of “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”. Pre-orders for “Fallen Angel” open on 24 September, the same day the mini-album’s fourth single from that campaign, “Trying to Save You”, arrives on streaming platforms in a mix by Olaf Wollschläger. The title track follows as a single on 21 October with a new music video featuring the band, ahead of the full CD and vinyl release on 27 November. The tracklist: Fallen Angel Protect Your Neck Not This Time The Meeting of the Broken Tilt Trying to Save You (single mix) The Truth Doesn’t Matter (live, recorded on this tour) Fallen Angel (extended version) Trying to Save You (remix) “Fallen Angel”, “Protect Your Neck”, “Not This Time” and “The Meeting of the Broken” are entirely new songs; “Tilt” receives its first physical release. Mark Hockings and Richard Silverthorn wrote and recorded all tracks and produced the mini-album with Vaughn George on live keyboards and Sean Suleman on live drums; it was recorded at Mesh HQ and The Summerhouse in Bristol, mixed by Olaf Wollschläger and Mesh at Cottonbeat Studio in Burscheid, Germany, with additional mastering by Wollschläger. Mark Hockings supplied the artwork and photography, with additional artwork, editing and layout by Nico Janse van Rensburg. “Fallen Angel” will be released as a jewel case CD, a limited clear vinyl LP capped at 500 copies, and a standard black vinyl LP; the CD and a KitAlbum Tour Edition will be available at Mesh’s live shows roughly six weeks ahead of the wider release. Distribution runs through SPKR. At least two of the new songs will be played live starting with Mesh’s show in Krefeld, Germany, on 1 October. The band’s confirmed live dates through November: 1 October 2026 – Krefeld, Germany – Kulturfabrik 2 October 2026 – Braunschweig, Germany – Westand 3 October 2026 – Dresden, Germany – Reithalle Strasse E 4 October 2026 – Berlin, Germany – Kesselhaus 5 November 2026 – Łódź, Poland – Klub Scenografia 6 November 2026 – Halle/Saale, Germany – Capitol 7 November 2026 – Liberec, Czech Republic – Dům Kultury Liberec (Sever Synth Festival) Hockings and Silverthorn also confirmed that “Looking Skyward” is set to return on red vinyl “very, very soon”, and that “Who Watches Over Me?” will receive a 25th-anniversary reissue in 2027 as an art book edition with refreshed artwork, following the return of its rights from Sony Music; that album will also return to streaming platforms next year. The details emerged during a Zoom Q&A with Hockings and Silverthorn on 22 September, which Mesh had previously teased as previewing an “unusual release”. About Mesh Mesh formed in 1991 in the UK when vocalist and guitarist Mark Hockings and keyboard player and vocalist Richard Silverthorn began writing together, later joined by keyboardist Neil Taylor. The band released the “Fragile” EP in 1994 and its debut album, “In This Place Forever”, in 1996, followed by “The Point at Which It Falls Apart” in 1999, reissued in a 25th-anniversary edition in 2024. The major-label release “Who Watches Over Me?” in 2002 widened the band’s European audience, especially in Germany, and 2006’s “We Collide” was produced with former Depeche Mode collaborator Gareth Jones. “Automation Baby” (2013) reached number 33 on the German album chart, and “Looking Skyward” (2016) climbed to number 12 there. Mesh continued as the core duo of Hockings and Silverthorn, touring with drummer Sean Suleman and additional live keyboard players, and added Vaughn George to the live lineup in April 2023. Hockings also records solo as Blackcarburning, releasing the album “Watching Sleepers” and the EP “Divide Us”. Mesh’s most recent album, “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”, arrived in 2026 on Dependent Records, preceded by the singles “Exile”, “Hey Stranger” and “This World” and followed by a European tour; “Fallen Angel”, out 27 November 2026, extends that album cycle with new songs, remixes and a live recording.
items._cn_summary: 这是英国二人组 Mesh 即将在 Dependent Records 发行的迷你专辑《Fallen Angel》的曲目与发行信息新闻稿。专辑包含四首全新歌曲、一首现场录音及若干混音版本，被定位为 2026 年专辑《The Truth Doesn't Matter》的补充延伸，而非全新篇章。所有曲目由 Mark Hockings 与 Richard Silverthorn 创作并制作，由 Olaf Wollschläger 协助混音，发行涵盖 CD、限量透明黑胶及标准黑胶版本。文章详细列出了演出日程与预售信息，但未涉及任何音乐风格、编曲手法或艺术评价方面的乐评内容，仅为纯新闻性质的发布公告。

The musical partnership between Kalaniemi and Alakotila has thrived over a remarkable 35 years, long enough to the Finnish pair to develop a stunning intimacy and telepathy. Kalaniemi is a lovingly melodic accordion player, with a sharp ear for a good tune, building each one into a thing of great beauty, while pianist Alakotila not only supports her but adds enough of his own to help transform every piece into a glistening gem.
There�s a sense of calmness to the work here, a long, sweet exhalation between two instrumentalists who are deep enough in sync to allow seamless improvisation beyond any written score and carry the listeners along with them. For much of the album, it�s just the pair of them, including Kalaniemi�s wordless voice, as on the opener, the tradional �Lyck�nskan.� She does charmingly sing lyrics on the title track, written by Lasse M�rtenson, with the sound there neatly and sparingly expanded with the addition of a string quartet.
Morgondimma
There are several original pieces alongside the tradition, with Kalaniemi�s �Hambo Vid F�bodan� a real standout, and it�s perhaps inevitable on any disc featuring accordion that a Piazzolla tune should be included, brings its own shadows to the whole (�Oblivion�). And, this being Finland, a tango is almost obligatory, in this case Alakotila�s �Tango Berlin.�
Tango Berlin
There�s a gentle, dreamlike quality to so much of this, flowing and mellifluous. The pieces aren�t an arena for showy virtuosity. Instead, the two musicians serve the tune, exploring and genuinely enjoying their performances.
It won�t shake the earth, but it makes for some true listening beauty.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由芬兰手风琴演奏家Maria Kalaniemi与钢琴家Timo Alakotila合作呈现，二人搭档三十五年的默契贯穿始终。专辑以北欧民谣为基底，融合传统曲目与原创作品，Kalaniemi旋律感敏锐，Alakotila则以钢琴形成细腻支撑，两者即兴互动如水乳交融。部分曲目加入弦乐四重奏或Kalaniemi的人声，扩展了简约的二乐器框架。曲风温和舒缓，带有梦境般的流动感，不追求炫技而专注于旋律本身的雕琢。整体呈现平静甜美的审美取向，在技法与情感表达上都偏向传统的室内民谣语汇，缺乏显著的实验性或跨界突破元素。对于偏好实验、前卫或融合性声响的听众而言，这张作品的探索边界较为保守，吸引力有限。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: Tiny Sun 的专辑《Vanishment》由三位长期远程合作的音乐人共同创作，以弹拨吉他、尤克里里、滑音吉他与清脆键盘构筑出十八首微型小品，总时长仅三十四分钟。歌曲主题围绕失去的爱、信心以及对世界荒诞的无奈接受，嗓音清澈高亢且偶显脆弱。作品风格被描述为模糊的美式民谣，融入了矿工布鲁斯、灵魂乡村与多莉·帕顿式的山草韵味，甚至有如老电影片尾曲般的怀旧编排。评论以细腻的笔触描绘了专辑的克制美学与梦境般气质，但也指出其本质上是精致的民谣流行小品，与实验、前卫、电子或世界音乐等路径距离较远。对于偏好先锋声响设计的听众而言，这张专辑的温婉与保守缺乏足够的刺激点。
